canonical_name: Existence of a seven-dimensional exotic sphere
source_claim_translation: There exists a seven-dimensional exotic sphere.
canonical_statement: There exists a smooth seven-dimensional manifold homeomorphic to the standard topological 7-sphere but not diffeomorphic to the standard smooth 7-sphere.
domain_and_universes: A Lean model of a smooth real 7-manifold and the standard unit 7-sphere in Real^8; universe levels and manifold models remain to be selected at the statement gate.
quantifiers: there exists a smooth seven-dimensional manifold M
there exists a homeomorphism between M and the standard 7-sphere
hypotheses: M carries the smooth-manifold structure required by the selected Lean encoding
the comparison object is the standard smooth 7-sphere
conclusion: There is no diffeomorphism from M to the standard smooth 7-sphere.
statement_choices_requiring_source_audit: the exact Lean representation of a smooth manifold and the standard unit 7-sphere
whether the witness is abstract or the total space of a specified S^3-bundle over S^4
whether orientation data belongs to the root or only to the obstruction argument
whether non-diffeomorphism is represented by IsEmpty of a Diffeomorph type or by negated existence
excluded_degenerate_cases: The dimension is fixed to seven. A merely homotopy-equivalent non-homeomorphic manifold and the standard smooth sphere itself do not witness the claim. Orientation-preserving-only non-diffeomorphism is not sufficient unless source audit shows that it implies the unoriented conclusion.
